Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
BENDER, PLATE, ORTHOPAEDIC 



( Reaffirmed 1992) 



1. Scope — Covers dimensional and other requirements for plate bender used in orthopaedic 
surgery. 

2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1. 




All dimensions In millimetres. 
FIG. 1 BENDER. PLATE, ORTHOPAEDIC 

2.1 A deviation of ±2'5 percent shall be allowed on all dimensions. 

3. Material — Stainless steel conforming to Designation 20Cr13 or 30Cr13 of 18:6603-1972 
' Specification for stainless steel bars and flats '. 

4. Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 The bender shall be free from rough edges, cracks, pits and other surface defects. 

4.2 All edges shall be rounded. 

4.3 It shall be polished bright and passivated. 

5. Heat Treatment — The bender shall be hardened and tempered to a hardness of 400 to 450 HV» 

6. Performance Test— Hold in a suitable vice an osteotomy plate conforming to 18:5171-1969 
' Specification for bone plate, Kessei, osteotomy* of 5 mm thicl^ness. Twist the plate through 90"* by 
one end of the bender. The bender shali show no sign of damage. Repeat the test with the other 
end of the bender. 

7. Marking — Mark with the manufacturer's name, initials or recognized trade-mark and the words 
' stainless steel '. 

7.1 ISl Certification l\4arking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

8. Packing — As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. 



Adopted 22 April 1975
